Intro: I heard the news, do not appear foolish in front of me. You hold sin in your eyes. The fucking Duchess! She was in your grasp, and you let her go!?
What, do you not believe in vengeance… Oh… Oh no… my throat feels wet, too wet. I can't be doing this now…
I cannot believe I let my temper get the best of me… I have failed them… Have I failed you too, Grandpa? Don't let your curse take me, please?
